instruction.text: Now you're facing a window. Turn slightly towards you're right and exit the room. Now there is a narrow passage in front of you, walk through the narrow passage and walk towards the closed door which is in front of you. Now take a left turn and you can find an another narrow passage. Walk in that narrow passage passing few portraits on the right side. Walk till you reach a bedroom where on the left side you can see a bed. Slightly turn towards your left and move forwards towards the glass grill. Now turn left and you can see a ash curtain in front of you and that is the end point.
